CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to the identified content is present.

COD.rationale: Content (red positions) plus an explicit origin/representation status on the same candidate/current node are present.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-condition linked to content organization/access is stated.

C.rationale: Content coordinates are explicitly listed for named records/candidates.

D.rationale: Origins/status fields are provided separately from listed content coordinates, distinguishing identification from representation status.

O.rationale: Explicit origin/representation-state entries describe how content is currently represented/accessed; a display-orientation statement describes presentation.
